title: DEAPvst~
description: `DEAPvst~` is a GUI for the `vstplugin~` object, receiving audio through its L~ and R~ inlets for audio plugins and data through its Data inlet for MIDI plugins. It runs each plugin on an individual thread; if this overloads the processor, remove `-p` from both `[open -e -p $1(` message boxes inside `DEAPvst~`.
